real_reader_proof.scalar_note: w-scaler SCALAR reader (no PX_PER_CLK/rd_*_n) produces bit-identical G0/G1 to this bus TB — metric measures full-line refill only; rd_x+=2 skips odd display samples but refill still reads whole lines. NOT a PPC2 correctness proof.
real_reader_proof.recipe_note: TB top may set PX_PER_CLK=2 and driver rd_x+=2, but beat-delta is full-line refill demand — scalar/no-rd_*_n control is bit-identical. PPC2 correctness is a separate gate (distinct+scalar NEG), not this bus metric.

cpu_time_not_rate.note: T_copy_arm is CPU TIME on the ONE effective ARM core; R_req 33.1776 is fabric payload RATE — not interchangeable. Do not budget copy on a second core.

path_a_overlap.why: Decode||copy overlap needs a second ARM core concurrent with decode. MiSTer framework permanently owns one core; effective capacity is one core. Contended-core case is the design case — not idle dual-core.
